entities.name: Zdeněk Měřínský
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Zdeněk Měřínský was a Czech archeologist and historian specializing in medieval archaeology, Czech and Austrian medieval history, casteollogy, evolution of the settlement structure, and topography. He was the head of the Department of Archaeology and Museology at the Masaryk University. He also lectured at other universities. He was the author of several hundred scientific studies, author or co-author of several important monographs.

entities.summary: Zdeněk Měřínský was a Czech archeologist and historian specializing in medieval archaeology, Czech and Austrian medieval history, casteollogy, evolution of the settlement structure, and topography. He was the head of the Department of Archaeology and Museology at the Masaryk University. He also lectured at other universities. He was the author of several hundred scientific studies, author or co-author of several important monographs.
